## What this part will cover

- Rarefaction curves, and the debate about rarefying.
- Alpha diversity (Shannon, Chao1) with a paired test.
- Beta diversity: Aitchison and Jaccard distances, ordination.
- PERMANOVA with permutations within each child, dispersion, and effect sizes.
